topics.title: UpKeep Tech Certifications
topics.summary: OSHA 10 yes, but EPA lead-safe (RRP) is the real must-have in Detroit.
topics.detail: OSHA 10 Construction is a voluntary $59, 10-hour online card: worth it, not legally required. Legally needed: EPA RRP renovator (8-hour class, $200 to $305, 5 yrs) plus a $300 EPA Lead-Safe firm cert, since 91% of Detroit homes are pre-1978; and employer ladder training (free ALI course). Michigan limits unlicensed techs to minor plumbing (clogs, faucets, valves), electrical wiring of $100 or less, and no HVAC repair. Strongly recommended: Red Cross First Aid/CPR (~$100), NATE Ready-to-Work ($60). Look-good extras: EPA 608 Type I ($24.95), HVAC Excellence exams ($15), Nest Pro (free), a $10K bond (~$125/yr), background checks.

topics.title: Anonymous Builder Brand
topics.summary: Quiet, Banksy-style attention for free playable drops.
topics.detail: Pseudonymous makers like tinysoul and small vibe-coded game accounts grew on X with free playable drops and one visual signature. True anonymity is hard and clashes with the Max Weberman footer and customer businesses, so the pick is a semi-anon studio name with a quiet link back. Three paths: studio name (M), semi-anon persona (S, recommended), open build in public (S to L).

topics.detail: 13 tools with current prices: Meta glasses for hands-free visit clips (LED shows when recording; Michigan lets participants record their own conversations, but get the member's OK in their home), nameplate OCR into the home record, QR tags, thermal camera, moisture meter, borescope, smart leak shutoffs as an add-on, thermostat alerts, drone roof checks (Part 107), 3D scans, AI defect spotting and AR overlays.

topics.title: UpKeep Pricing Forecast
topics.summary: Plus is the likely pick; about $228/mo average.
topics.detail: Base case: 30% Essentials, 55% Plus, 15% Complete, about $167/mo on tiers plus $61 in add-ons, so about $228/mo per customer (range $189 to $278). Top add-on is lawn mowing, then snow, pest, leaf cleanup, windows and pressure washing.
